summary: Browser cookie stealer exfiltrating document.cookie to webhook.site
details: The package ships a single script exposed via both the npm `main` entry and the `unpkg` CDN field. When loaded in a browser, the script reads `document.cookie` and navigates `window.location.href` to `https://webhook.site/4c14c8e4-721e-471d-807c-1a2aa216512a/` with the cookie value appended to the URL path, leaking any cookies accessible to the including page to that collector. The identifiers `location`, `href`, and `cookie` are assembled at runtime from split string fragments (`"loca"+"tion"`, `"hr"+"ef"`, `"coo"+"kie"`) to conceal the exfiltration mechanism from simple pattern scans. There is no functionality beyond this cookie-theft path.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
